description: Quantitative value aligned to schema.org QuantitativeValue (value, min_value, max_value, unit, unit_text) with BattINFO extension typical_value.

co_type.description: Deprecated alias of value_basis; accepted so existing records keep validating.

conditions.description: Measurement parameters or conditions under which this quantity holds, as a map of condition name to quantity (e.g. discharging_c_rate, lower_voltage_limit, upper_voltage_limit, temperature, cycle_number, voltage_reference). A qualitative condition may carry value_text alone, with no unit. In JSON-LD, conditions emit as hasMeasurementParameter on a measurement node the quantity isOutputOf; the voltage_reference key instead emits as hasMetrologicalReference on the quantity itself.

max_value.description: Upper bound when the source specifies a range.

min_value.description: Lower bound when the source specifies a range.

sample_count.description: How many members the value (and standard_deviation) were computed over — e.g. 8 electrode discs. Without it a spread cannot be read.

standard_deviation.description: Dispersion of the sample the value summarises, in the same unit as value. A sample standard deviation over sample_count members, not a measurement uncertainty. Zero is meaningful: it says every member carried the same number.

typical_value.description: Typical value when the source distinguishes typical from nominal or limit values.

unit.description: Canonical compact unit symbol/code, for example V, A, Ah, Wh/kg.

unit_text.description: Human-readable unit text as written in the source (schema.org unitText).

value.description: Point value, numeric or as a string when the source value is not purely numeric.

value_basis.description: The basis on which the value is stated. Nominal: the design or target value as specified (default for spec records). Measured: obtained by measurement on a physical item (default for instance records). Rated: a guaranteed value established under a stated rating procedure (datasheet rated capacity). Conventional: fixed by convention or standard practice.

value_text.description: Verbatim value text when the source value cannot be parsed to a number.

title: Quantity
